use_case_and_requirements: Primary workload: chat-based in-app assistant + occasional document summarization. Targets: p50 < 300ms for short Q/A (< 200 tokens), p95 < 1.5s for typical flows. Throughput: ~30 concurrent users peak, cost sensitive. Prefers public cloud hosted API; wants simple region routing and prompt length guidance. Model preference: mid-sized open models (13B quant) or similar to balance cost/latency. Needs ability to set client timeouts, and fallback to smaller model when high-latency observed.
prompt_guidance_given: Region: recommend routing EU traffic to eu-central-1 or eu-west-1 endpoint instead of global default to cut RTT ~100-200ms
Client timeout: set read timeout to 60s for non-streaming completions; for typical short replies use 8-15s to detect failures earlier
Streaming: enable streaming responses for faster time-to-first-byte; client should display tokens as they arrive
Prompt length: cap context to ~1k tokens for chat UI; move long documents to embeddings + retrieval to keep generation prompt small
Token caps: set max_output_tokens to 256 for support replies to control latency and cost
Backoff & retries: exponential backoff with jitter; avoid aggressive retries that cause thundering herd
Batching: not recommended for low-latency interactive chat; use batching for offline reranking/embeddings jobs
Fallbacks: configure automatic fallback to a smaller, faster model variant under high tail latency conditions
